req.title: Login required for create
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /create.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to access the '/create' endpoint. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can create new posts, maintaining the integrity and security of the blogging platform. The test suite will verify this behavior by checking the redirection for anonymous users, ensuring that authenticated users can access the endpoint, and testing the boundary condition of session management.

tests.name: test_create_redirects_anonymous_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/create')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == 'http://localhost/auth/login'

tests.name: test_create_accessible_to_logged_in_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
response = client.get('/create')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'Create' in response.data

tests.name: test_create_redirect_boundary_session_expiry
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    sess.pop('user_id', None)
response = client.get('/create')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == 'http://localhost/auth/login'
